THE ARITHMETIC, AND THE ONE JUDGMENT TERM DECLARED. Two independent purpose-built NET quantities land on my day and they agree: n0_net_sigma_5 = 137 (the fresh net scale of this regime) and the census's largest-CDD-revision class median |move| = 180 (n=3: 230/60/180). That ratio is an invention - two b_share numbers combined in a way neither was measured for - and it is exactly the confabulated-derivation failure the brief names, so I struck it rather than absorbing it.

That give-back is why the path is not a monotone creep, and it is the one place my leg's identity changes the shape. 06:00-10:00: the near-term add (+0.508 on D0) puts a floor under it and pre-print positioning is quiet and two-sided - +10 -> +20 -> +30. This is the REOPEN-to-10:30 window that daytype.eia_window_reopen_to_print defines, and the chain's residual did deliver inside it, overnight, as that play says it does on gate-fired days. 10:30 PRINT, the day's one genuine liquidity event: it carries a zero-mean impulse for me by construction (expectation on the month median, no consensus to be surprised against), so it shows up in the p50 as the flow chain's small unconfirmed buy tilt being delivered rather than as a jump - +30 -> +180 by 12:00, the day's high-water region. 12:00-17:00: the absorber that has been selling size for three straight sessions works against it and the pop is not fully held - +180 -> +150 -> +125 -> +115. That is my lens's 0326 class in its price-free form: a pop that meets absorption round-trips PARTIALLY, and the honest emission is the partial, not the full round-trip I cannot verify without price. A hill slopes; nothing in this path gaps except the gap itself, which is carried separately.

STEP 5 - PRE-MORTEM AND ANTI-DEFAULT. Assume I am wrong. The three things most against me, named in advance. (1) daytype.storage_thursday_magnitude's SIZE arm, which I declined on the strength of its own G22-discharged falsifier - if G22 was the exception rather than the rule, +140 is far too small on a day that runs 800-1,400, and n0_range_20_max = 2110 says this same regime produced exactly that inside 20 sessions. (2) flow.price_free_absorption_proxy's named live counterexample 0507 (bp 0.427, n 89) which was followed by +730 - my configuration is that class, and if the absorber is not really there the flip runs and I am badly under on the correct side. (3) THE SIGN, which is the likeliest way I am wrong: my own pre-influence read said DOWN, and a print materially above +48 into a balance that has already loosened ~1 Bcf/d takes the day the other way. ANTI-DEFAULT CHECK (magnitude.emission_ceiling_check): +140 is nowhere near the measured ~$550 emission ceiling, so I am not silently emitting the cap - but the mirror question is whether small is my default shape, and it is not: +140 is at the SMALL end of the walk's emissions and it is small for three named measured reasons that agree (a 33rd-percentile range regime with a 137 fresh net sigma; a revision size class that delivered 230/60/180; a print expectation sitting on its month's median with the surprise channel absent). I ran the play's own instruction to SUM independent drivers rather than emit the dominant one: summing does not raise this number, because what the day carries is three suppressors, one small up-tilt, and one fat upper tail - and the tail is a BAND term, not a p50 term, so it is in expected_magnitude_band_usd where it belongs and not in the p50 where it would be a fabrication.
